description: This article shows you how to use Microsoft Sentinel with Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
summary: Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) combined with Microsoft Sentinel can provide security information event management for WAF resources. Microsoft Sentinel provides security analytics using Log Analytics, which allows you to easily break down and view your WAF data. Using Microsoft Sentinel, you can access pre-built workbooks and modify them to best fit your organization's needs.
